title: Tool disambiguation & argument sanity eval harness for config/model regression detection
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Recent customer incidents and internal smoke tests exposed cases where model/config changes alter tool selection behavior (different tool picked) and produce malformed or semantically invalid tool arguments. We need an automated evaluation harness that detects such regressions as early as possible and ties alerts to specific config/model diffs.

Goal: Build a repeatable, data-driven eval harness that measures: 1) tool selection accuracy (correct tool chosen vs. gold label), 2) argument schema conformance and semantic validity (required fields present, types, ranges, and cross-field consistency), and 3) sensitivity of selection/argument correctness to: model family/version, routing config, and function-mapping overrides. The harness must run on PRs and on nightly canary/model-rollouts and surface actionable diffs.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Baseline dataset (gold set) of 4k+ labeled prompts covering: ambiguous tool intents, edge-case entities, long-context prompts, and chained calls must be curated and stored in the eval bucket.
- Harness implements two core metrics: ToolSelectionAccuracy (micro & macro) and ArgValidityRate (percentage of calls passing schema + semantic checks).
- Regression detection: any delta > 2.5 percentage points for ToolSelectionAccuracy or > 4 percentage points for ArgValidityRate triggers a failed run and creates an annotatable alert.
- PR gate: CI job runs a fast 200-sample smoke eval against changed model/config and posts summarized artifacts (confusion matrix, sample counterexamples) to the PR.
- Canary job: nightly run compares canary vs baseline models and writes a time-series to the eval dashboard; if regression persists for 3 runs, auto-creates a bug ticket assigned to the model-onboarding owner.
- All failures link back to exact config diffs and the canonical prompt(s) that produced the divergence.

Design notes & trade-offs:
- Fast vs. thorough: PR smoke must be lightweight (~<5m). Nightly full harness can be larger and include semantic checks that use lightweight execution of the function logic in a sandbox.
- Semantic validation will be layered: 1) schema (JSON schema) 2) domain sanity rules (e.g., price field in cents >0, currency codes valid) 3) mocked execution where applicable. Mocked execution increases signal but risks false positives; will be flagged separately in reports.
- Coverage: prioritize customer-triggered tool families (payments, calendar, DB-query) and models most likely to be used in production.

Implementation plan (high level):
1) Dataset: curate gold prompts, labels, and canonical expected args into sources bucket. Owner: PM (Janelle Ortiz).
2) Metric impl: add ToolSelectionAccuracy + ArgValidityRate into eval-lib and exportable JSON. Owner: ENG (Liam Chen).
3) CI integration: small smoke harness (200 examples randomized with stratified sampling) executed in PR pipeline; artifacts uploaded to s3 and PR comment posted. Owner: CI infra (Rohit Singh).
4) Canary pipeline: nightly full harness, write metrics to Prometheus + Grafana eval dashboard; alerts on sustained regression. Owner: SRE (Marta Ivanov).
5) Reporter: human-readable diff report generator that attaches top-N counterexamples and confusions to generated bug ticket. Owner: Eng Tools (Aisha Patel).

Acceptance test scenarios:
- Introduce a controlled change to the routing config that reorders routing priority; verify harness flags drop in ToolSelectionAccuracy and surfaces exact prompts failing.
- Deploy a model variant with reduced context-window handling; verify harness flags argument truncation errors and malformed arg shapes.

Risks & mitigation:
- Flaky semantic checks: mitigate by storing deterministic seeds and using mocked runtimes for nondeterministic external calls.
- Dataset bias: mitigate by continuous label audits and rotating sampling from production telemetry (privacy-scrubbed).
- CI cost: keep PR smoke small; allow opt-outs for trivial doc-only PRs.

Metrics to monitor post-launch: baseline ToolSelectionAccuracy, ArgValidityRate, mean time to detect, mean time to triage, false positive rate of harness, PR runtime.

Related artifacts: confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INFR/Tool+Disambiguation+Eval+Design, eval-bucket: s3://redwood-evals/tool-disambiguation/gold-v1/, dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd123/tool-invocation-evals
